lock.backupReminder: Back up your account key to avoid losing access

account.activeDesc: Active account — apps will use this profile
account.noAccountDesc: Create a new account or import an existing one to get started.
account.switchConfirmDesc: Apps will start using this account for all requests.
account.noSitesHint: Sites will appear here when they request access
account.deleteDesc: This removes the account from this extension. Make sure you have your backup key saved.
account.deleteDescLocal: This will permanently remove your keys from this extension. Without a backup key, you will lose access to this account forever.
account.deleteDescRemote: This will remove the connection to your signer app. Your account is still safe on the signer — you can reconnect anytime.

wizard.addAccountDesc: Your account lets you log in to apps, post, and send messages — all without a central server.
wizard.modeNewDesc: Generate a fresh key pair with a 12-word recovery phrase you can back up.
wizard.modeImportDesc: Paste your nsec private key or 64-character hex secret.
wizard.modeSignerDesc: Your keys stay on a signer app (nsec.app, Amber, Primal). Most secure option.
wizard.chooseNameDesc: Pick a name people will see when they interact with you. You can change it anytime.
wizard.importAccountDesc: Enter the backup key from your existing account to restore it here.
wizard.connectSignerDesc: Paste the connection link from your signer app.
wizard.nameHint: This is how others see you. Use your real name, a nickname, or anything you like.
wizard.keySecurityHint: Your key stays on this device. It's encrypted and never shared with anyone.
wizard.nsecWhereToFind: Your nsec key is in your existing Nostr app's settings, usually under 'Keys' or 'Backup'.
wizard.invalidKeyFormat: Enter a valid nsec key or 64-character hex private key
wizard.invalidMnemonic: Invalid recovery phrase — check spelling and word order
wizard.signerHint: Get this from your signer app (nsec.app, Amber, Primal). Your keys stay there — we never see them.
wizard.nostrConnectHint: A QR code will be generated for your signer app to scan. Your keys never leave the signer.
wizard.connectTimeout: This may take up to 30 seconds
wizard.backupDesc: This is the only way to recover your account. If you lose it, no one can help — not even us.
wizard.backupWarning: Never share this with anyone — it controls your entire account
wizard.backupConfirm: I've saved my recovery key in a secure place
wizard.backupConfirmHint: Use a password manager (1Password, Bitwarden), encrypted notes, or write it down on paper and store it safely.
wizard.profileDesc: Review your profile info. You can update this anytime.
wizard.completeProfileDesc: Add a bit more about yourself. This helps others recognize you.
wizard.connectedDesc: Your signer is linked and ready to use
wizard.signerExplainer: Your keys stay safely on the signer app. When an app needs to act as you, the request is sent to your signer for approval.
wizard.modeRecoverDesc: Restore your account using the 12 recovery words you saved.
wizard.recoverAccountDesc: Enter the 12 recovery words you saved when you created your account.
wizard.recoveryWordsPlaceholder: Enter your 12 words separated by spaces
wizard.recoveryWordsHint: Enter the words in the exact order you received them.
wizard.mnemonicWarning: Write these words down — they're the only way to recover your account
wizard.backupMnemonicDesc: These 12 words are the only way to recover your account. Write them down and keep them safe.
wizard.doneDesc: Your account is ready. Apps can now ask to use it — you'll always be asked first.
wizard.profileSyncLater: Some servers couldn't be reached — your profile will sync later
wizard.pinTitle: Pin Buho Jump to your toolbar
wizard.pinDesc: Click the puzzle piece icon in your browser toolbar and pin Buho Jump for quick access.

prompt.allowAllDesc: This site will be able to:
prompt.allowAllCheck2: Request signatures for posts and actions
prompt.httpWarning: This site is not secure — your data could be intercepted
prompt.permPublicWhat: The app wants to know who you are — like showing your profile card.
prompt.permPublicDetail: This only shares your public info. It cannot post or act on your behalf.
prompt.permSignWhat: The app wants to publish something using your account — like a post, reaction, or action.
prompt.permSignDetail: This is like pressing "send". The content will be visible to others.
prompt.permEncryptWhat: The app wants to send a private message that only the recipient can read.
prompt.permEncryptDetail: The message will be encrypted before it's sent.
prompt.permDecryptWhat: The app wants to open a private message that was sent to you.
prompt.permDecryptDetail: The decrypted message will be visible to the app.
prompt.permWeblnWhat: The app wants to interact with your Lightning wallet — check balance and create invoices.
prompt.permWeblnDetail: This does not allow the app to send payments without your approval.
prompt.permWeblnPayWhat: The app wants to pay a Lightning invoice using your wallet.
prompt.permWeblnPayDetail: Sats will leave your wallet. Only approve if you trust this app and expected this payment.
prompt.rememberBudgetHint: Auto-approve future payments within this budget
prompt.permDefaultWhat: This app is requesting access to your account.

wallet.noTransactionsHint: Send or receive sats to get started
wallet.disconnectDesc: You'll need to paste your wallet connection link again to reconnect.
wallet.noWalletDesc: Paste the connection link from your wallet app to enable payments.
wallet.noWalletHomeDesc: Connect a Lightning wallet to send and receive sats instantly.
wallet.nwcHelp: Get this from your wallet app (Alby, Mutiny, Coinos). Look for "Nostr Wallet Connect" in the wallet's settings.
wallet.removeWalletDesc: This wallet connection will be removed. You can add it back later.
wallet.rateUnavailable: Exchange rate unavailable — enter amount in sats instead
wallet.receiveHintCashu: Create a Lightning invoice or redeem an ecash token
wallet.receiveHintNwc: Create a Lightning invoice to receive sats
wallet.noResultsHint: Transactions will appear here once you send or receive payments
wallet.merchantExpiredDesc: The price quote has expired because exchange rates change constantly. Scan the QR code again to get a fresh quote.
wallet.merchantRateStale: Exchange rate may have changed. Confirm the amount is still correct before paying.
wallet.merchantNotSupported: {name} QR codes are not yet supported. Only EMVCo retail QR codes (Pick n Pay, Checkers, Woolworths) work currently.
wallet.merchantInsufficientBalance: Not enough sats in your wallet for this payment. Top up your balance and try again.
wallet.amountTooLow: Amount must be greater than zero
wallet.insufficientBalance: Not enough sats for this payment. Your balance is {balance} sats.
wallet.paymentFailed: Payment could not be completed. Check your wallet balance and internet connection.
wallet.addressResolveFailed: Could not resolve this address. Check it's correct and try again.
wallet.lnurlFailed: Could not complete this request. The service may be temporarily unavailable.
wallet.connectFailedDetail: Could not connect to wallet. Make sure your connection link is correct and not expired.
wallet.withdrawSuccessDesc: The sats have been added to your wallet
wallet.withdrawFailed: Could not claim this payment. The link may have expired or already been used.
wallet.backupDesc: Download an encrypted backup of your wallet.
wallet.backupRestoreDesc: Recover your wallet from your Nostr relays.
wallet.backupNoData: No backup found on your relays
wallet.backupWarning: Anyone with this file can spend these funds. Store it safely.
wallet.removeWalletWarning: This will permanently delete all funds in this wallet. Make sure you have a backup.
